title: Hobgoblin silk gowns and night parades
summary: Hobgoblins wore blue silk gowns and caps, paraded at night and never played funerals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: What kind of uniforms did the Hobgoblin band wear? Uniforms? Uh-huh. You said they were different. Oh, they had the—they had the—the silk gown, you know.
And the silk cap. Yeah, they had the silk gown and the silk gown. Were they blue or green or yellow or what? They were blue. Blue, huh? Yes, indeed.
They had the parade at night. They had the parade at night. Just at night?
We were parading today. They looked like ghosts at night.
Well then, the Hobgoblins never played funerals.
